claim_text: Four remaining 22-CR-223/22-CR-124 defendants, previously listed in this corpus only as 'charged,' pleaded guilty per Sahan Journal's own guilty-pleas tracker: Ahmed Mohamed Artan pleaded guilty to one count of wire fraud (ran Stigma-Free International, claimed to serve 5 million meals; also co-created Olive Management, Optimum Community Services, and the Five A's Project shell company) and was later sentenced to two years and nine months in prison on August 13, 2026; Asad Mohamed Abshir pleaded guilty to one count of wire fraud (helped his brother Abdinasir Mahamed Abshir run a Stigma-Free food site in Mankato); Hamdi Hussein Omar pleaded guilty to one count of wire fraud (operator of the Stigma-Free Waite Park food site, which collected $1.4 million); Mahad Ibrahim pleaded guilty to one count of wire fraud and one count of money laundering (ran ThinkTechAct Foundation, tied to the Empire Cuisine trial group); and Abdirahman Mohamud Ahmed, known professionally as Chef Abcos, pleaded guilty to one count of money laundering (co-owner of Safari Restaurant), with prosecutors requesting probation and no prison time because he spent rather than obtained the fraudulent proceeds.

supporting_passages.quote: Ahmed Artan, pleaded guilty to one count of wire fraud... Mahad Ibrahim, 46, ran ThinkTechAct Foundation, pleaded guilty to one count of wire fraud and one count of money laundering.
Ahmed Artan was sentenced to two years and nine months in prison on Aug. 13, 2026.

amounts.methodology: Upper bound of Ahmed Mohamed Artan's plea-agreement restitution range ($250,000-$666,000), per Sahan Journal; not confirmed against a primary judgment.

qualifiers: No primary court record has been captured for any of these five defendants; all dispositions rest on Sahan Journal's own reporting.

Only Ahmed Mohamed Artan has a confirmed sentencing date in this pass; Asad Mohamed Abshir, Hamdi Hussein Omar, Mahad Ibrahim, and Abdirahman Mohamud Ahmed remain 'pleaded' with no sentencing date found.
Do not confuse Asad Mohamed Abshir with his brother Abdinasir Mahamed Abshir (fof-d-010), a separately tracked and already-sentenced defendant.
editorial_notes: Third source-batch in the defendant-by-defendant disposition reconciliation pass following the 'we need to cover all' instruction; identified via Sahan Journal's own guilty-plea and sentencing trackers, which this corpus was previously unable to fetch (client-rendering/blocking concerns noted in earlier passes) but retrieved successfully this pass via a direct fetch with a browser user-agent.
